statement: The labels below were prompt prose. They were never a repository artifact, they were never applied, and they produce no acceptance evidence. The derivation of an additional acceptance profile layer returned not_justified, so no profile artifact and no profile schema is created and the labels stay locked permanently rather than until the next block.
exempt_reason: Only the declaration itself may name the locked labels, because it has to name them in order to forbid them.

preserved_check.relation: Preserved unchanged and sharpened, not replaced. The K1 check keeps its own scope; this lock adds the permanent repository wide scope.

existing_acceptance_profiles_are_untouch.note: These really exist and are not affected. The lock concerns only the never defined labels.

historical_evidence.note: No historical statement is edited. The B0b finding that the labels do not exist stays exactly as it was written.
